topic: Making room for grief at Christmas (companion Reel, off grid, video experiment)
caption:
Missing someone can feel sharpest at Christmas.

The holidays are built from memory, so an absence can be felt more now. Researchers who studied widowed older adults suggest that sharing memories of the person, or quietly marking a special day, may help in the early months. Some people choose something small, like a candle or their name said out loud. There is no right way to do this season.

The short version of this week's carousel. The full carousel is on our profile @equal_psychology, and the full article is linked in bio.
